data.Title: The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender
data.Director: Steve Ahn, William Mata, Lauren Montgomery
data.Writer: Kenneth Lin, Michael Dante DiMartino, Bryan Konietzko
data.Actors: Eric Nam, Dave Bautista, Jessica Matten
data.Plot: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.
